use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: C2 JU
An operator initiates an IFF/SIF update request or a unit reports a No Data status requiring data exchange.

trigger.raw_text: An operator initiates an IFF/SIF update request or a unit reports a No Data status requiring data exchange.

claims.content: The C2 JU operator manually initiates an IFF/SIF update request by transmitting a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message with applicable mode indicators set.
Receiving R² units respond to the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message by initiating a J3.XC1 surveillance data report message regardless of their No Data status.

Receiving nonR² units respond to the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from an R² unit by initiating a J7.5 (ACT = 1) Difference Report message if they hold valid local data (nonzero codes) for the requested modes.
If the requested data has already been transmitted by another JU, remaining JUs need not respond with their local data.
NonR² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from other nonR² units do not respond to the request.

Data updating can occur spontaneously as a result of an R² unit reporting a No Data status (value 0) for one or more modes in a required IFF/SIF Surveillance data report (J3.XC1), serving as an alternative trigger to manual operator initiation.
Upon receiving a J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from a nonR² unit, other nonR² units will not respond to the request.
If a conflict is detected during difference resolution (indicated by code 'C' in the matrix), the unit does not accept the remote data and alerts the operator.
If an upgrade is detected but the data represents a downgrade (numerical decrease), the unit rejects the data and transmits local data in a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message.
If a downgrade is detected, the unit accepts the data but takes no further action unless it is an upgrade scenario requiring rejection.
Automatic transmission of a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message is inhibited if the same report is transmitted twice within 30 seconds; in this case, the operator is alerted instead.
IFF/SIF data commonality is insured between the Interface Units (IUs).
Receiving units have responded to the update request by transmitting their local data codes or surveillance data reports as required.
Any detected data conflicts have been resolved by the operator or flagged with an alert.
